## 8. POST-GEN NOTES
- Structure: the first full beat lands at about 0:07; the layout is "False start: two bars, dead silence, then the beat for real" and runs about 2:57. Straight mode: the same drums in every section, hard cuts only.
- Attitude: cold ("cold and still, the 808 doing the talking"). Menace without sadness: patient, even, nothing rushed.
- The mystery ingredient (the early kick) appears once, in the last hook: it is meant to be barely there and to send the track over the edge once. If Suno makes it constant, lower Style Influence five points; if it is missing, that is acceptable on a first take.
- No hint on this roll; the hook device in the lead line ("a five-note motif on a simple rise-and-fall shape, the second note always a sixteenth late, every pass") carries the stickiness. Listen for it on the second pass.
- It should still be hip hop: a head-nod drum pattern under the noise. If it comes back as a rock or dance track, re-roll.
- The lead is a machine sound, not an instrument; if it turns into a synth lead, change the seed.
- Distortion on the drums, a clean sub underneath: if the low end is mush, raise Style Influence five points.
- Fills, risers or a roll at a section change mean a word slipped through: run the QA checker on the block, and keep the anti-transition phrase in the drums line (it is the positive form of "no fills").
- Any hum, chant or sung syllable means a re-roll, not a fix: the Exclude list is already complete, so change the seed rather than adding words.
- Ending: [End] should stop it near 2:57. If it runs on, Crop to the last downbeat. If it stops early, Extend from the last good section and paste only the remaining section tags.
- Extend when the first 60-90 s are keepers and only the back half drifts. Re-roll (or run the weirder variation on v6-wild) when the drums or the lead are wrong from the start.
- Remaster: Remaster (Pro/Premier) renders subtle variations and runs on v6; use it on the keeper for a cleaner, louder master.
- Stems: Get Stems (Pro/Premier): Auto Split up to 12 stems for 50 credits; Split from Mix 10 credits per stem; Advanced Split (choose from ~100 instruments) 10 credits per stem, Premier only.
- Prompt ignored? Check Variety is Off (v6 defaults it to Normal, which rewrites the Style text) and Max Mode is on. Then check Style Influence is 70 or higher.
